label: Capacitor Polarized
description: Capacitor Polarized These are standard SMD and PTH capacitors. Normally 10uF, 47uF, and 100uF in electrolytic and tantalum varieties. Always verify the external diameter of the through hole cap, it varies with capacity, voltage, and manufacturer. The EIA devices should be standard.
